title: DMC3 HD Door TXT Parser Contract — Reconciled Pass 0–34

records.title: Door parser logical function starts near VA 0x1401A9DE0
records.summary: The reconciled Door TXT parser logical function begins near VA 0x1401A9DE0. The older 0x1401A9E3B anchor lies inside the parser loop and must not be treated as the logical function start.

locations.note: Corrected logical start anchor near VA 0x1401A9DE0; reconciled logical CFG has 68 blocks / 340 instructions.

records.title: Door parser table capacity is 12
records.summary: The vanilla Door parser stores at most 12 Door records in the confirmed table/capacity path. This is a parser/runtime capacity observation, not a claim that the complete Door record ABI has been recovered.

locations.note: Capacity check belongs to the reconciled Door parser path.

records.title: Door BoxIn, BoxLoad and AUTO grammar
records.summary: BoxIn consumes x y z radiusX radiusY radiusZ yaw. BoxLoad consumes four x,z pairs followed by yMin and yMax, for ten floats total. The AUTO path is observed through VA 0x1401AB6D0.

records.title: Corrected selected Door runtime record field offsets
records.summary: Reconciled runtime writes use Door record offsets +0xC8 and +0xD4. Their exact semantic field names and the complete record/class layout remain unresolved, so this evidence must not be expanded into a full Door ABI.

locations.note: Selected downstream record writes corrected to +0xC8 and +0xD4; complete Door record ABI remains open.
